qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Recipe-critical customer co-development of specialty vegetable oils and fats creates high switching costs for packaged food manufacturers; proved by 18.6% median ROIC and steady EBIT/kg expansion.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 6 (N, REJECT). Exemplary Swedish co-development specialty fats leader with 18.6% median ROIC, but structural working-capital absorption restricts multi-year FCF conversion to just 43% (negative FCF in FY22 and FY25), well below the 80% hurdle, alongside post-cocoa-spike margin normalization risk.
qualitative.evidence: 4-year cumulative Owner FCF of SEK 5,036M on GAAP Net Income of SEK 11,681M yields 43.1% FCF conversion due to commodity inventory working-capital swings. FY22 and FY25 produced negative FCF (-SEK 891M and -SEK 20M). 2024 peak EPS of SEK 13.57 was boosted by historic cocoa butter replacement windfalls.
